'''Transport TY-700''' was a [[Darius G-class freighter|''Darius G''-class freighter]] used by the [[First Order]] to transport [[fuel]]. Due to the [[starship]] being a model normally used by civilians, its allegiance to the First Order was not immediately apparent. In [[34 ABY]], it was used to deliver a fuel shipment to the ''[[Colossus]]'' platform on [[Castilon]]. [[Major]] [[Elrik Vonreg]] travelled aboard the ship for the delivery, as he had an [[Mission to Doza Tower|assignment]] to speak to the platform's owner, [[Captain]] [[Imanuel Doza]].<ref name="The High Tower" />
